hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools (YES/NO) that applies VALS dynamic fees using a signed off-chain sigma parameter. Fees are computed as e^[λ·(Δx/L)·σ] − 1, captured from the USDC collateral side of swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, and forwarded to a YieldDistributor for share token holders. Blocks trading when the market is resolved or disputed.
